newsitem.title: UK: Stan Chart repositions banking divisions.
newsitem.headline: Stan Chart repositions banking divisions.

text.p: Standard Chartered Bank said on Friday that David Moir, group executive director, would be responsible for both corporate and institutional banking.
In a statement it said its investment banking activities would move under Corporate Banking "except for residual trading activities which will be included under treasury".
Under the changes, Dave Loretta, chief executive of institutional banking, will report to Moir. Loretta will continue to be based in London, Standard Chartered said.
Garry Southern, who has been responsible for the repositioning of investment banking over the last two years, would "oversee the completion of this process and then move on from the bank", it added.

The statement said the changes to investment banking were with a view to "tightening its focus on services to the Standard Chartered franchise" and moving its actitivities to corporate banking was "a logical step in that process".
It said that having Loretta report to Moir and other organisational changes recognised the need to provide greater direct product and operations support to institutional banking.

"We are confident that this concentration of activities under one executive director will result in further improvement of our service to Standard Chartered's corporate and institutional cutomers," the bank said.
